comment: KE main MCU for the bed mesh scenario: same sensors and endstops as ke_live. BLTouch contact_steps: G28 Z first and second home, then the 25 BED_MESH_CALIBRATE probes in probe order (rows alternate direction, see the bed_mesh point table in the log). Mesh probes start at horizontal_move_z 5 (399.2 steps/mm), so 1133 steps is the z_offset 2.162 plane; the per-point offsets give a tilted, non-flat mesh.
